item.title: House Rejects Bipartisan Attempt To Block Trump From Using Military Force Against Venezuela
item.description: The House of Representatives rejected a bipartisan attempt Wednesday evening to reign in President Donald Trump's authority to use force against Venezuela.

item.title: Bongino Announces Exit From FBI, Thanks Trump and America as Speculation Swirls
item.description: His announcement followed growing questions about his future in the role.

item.title: Cops Arrest Man Reportedly Targeting ICE Agents, Tie Him To Leftist Terror Group
item.description: Federal authorities arrested a former U.S. Marine in Louisiana Friday after investigators say he plotted violence against federal immigration agents and maintained ties to a left-wing extremist network linked to a foiled New Year’s Eve bombing scheme.

item.title: Four Republicans Vote Against Banning Child Sex Changes
item.description: Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene secured one last victory before her quickly approaching resignation date in January 2026.

item.title: House Passes Last Minute GOP Healthcare Bill After Moderates Revolt
item.description: Republicans in the House of Representatives passed a healthcare reform bill on Wednesday evening targeting rising costs as expiring Obamacare tax credits rally support for change ahead of midterm elections.

item.title: More than 200 Dems Vote ‘No’ On Banning Transgender Treatments for Minors
item.description: The final tally was 216 to 211. While the partisan split was clear, there were notable crossovers.

item.title: Watch: Wasserman Schultz Says Trump a Bigger Threat Than Radical Islamic Jihad
item.description: “I think we have to focus, quite frankly, on, if we’re worried about the threat to American values, on the person who’s in the White House."

item.title: DAVID BLACKMON: Ford’s EV Fiasco Fallout Hits Hard
item.description: I’ve written frequently here in recent years about the financial fiasco that has hit Ford Motor Company and other big U.S. carmakers who made the fateful decision to go in whole hog in 2021 to feed at the federal subsidy trough wrought on the U.S. economy by the Joe Biden autopen presidency.

item.title: SUSAN BANE: Pregnancy Centers A Place For Trusted Care
item.description: Imagine fighting a case all the way to the Supreme Court of the United States—only to admit during oral arguments that the entire premise was based on a lie.
